notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable IEEE 1516.1-2025 interaction declaration foundation to the exact C++ API surfaces exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies only official signatures, declared exception sets, adapter symbols, and real Catch2 selectors. The implementation retains private per-federate publication/subscription state; the active/passive selector is preserved per ordinary subscription and only active state participates in the separate receive-order interaction path. Timestamped interaction, regions, directed interaction, FOM sharing-policy enforcement, MOM reporting, packaging, and conformance remain outside this declaration contract. The Lab exports no higher-level implementation mapping for these services, so this is source/API traceability only, not a catalog or validation claim.
